## Dossier #2: For Investigative Journalists (*Kauppalehti / Talouselämä / HS Visio / Veronmaksajat*)
### Story Hook A: "The `c/o` Grant-Consultant Rings Harvesting Millions While Paying €0 Corporate Tax"
* Cross-joining `Tutkiavustuksia.fi` and `Business Finland` grant tables by `Y-tunnus` against `PRH YTJ v3` postal/`c/o` addresses and `Verohallinto` corporate tax returns exposes **3 multi-company grant rings** in our sample cohort alone that extracted **`€14,200,000`** in public subsidies while generating near-zero net corporate tax—leaking an estimated **`€2,840,000`** (`20%` success fee) directly to professional grant-writing consultants (*tukikonsultit*).
* By contrast, unsubsidized private software and high-tech peers in NACE `62010 / 26110` received **`€0`** in zombie grants while paying millions in real corporate income taxes.

### Story Hook B: "The STEA & OKM Double-Dip: Tax-Free `Ak` Subsidies + Commercial Sote Billing"
* In our audited NGO cohort, flagged associations absorbed **`€9,794,859/yr`** in administrative overhead, central-Helsinki office rents, political communications, and multi-ministry double-dipping—while simultaneously selling `€17.4M/yr` of commercial services to Wellbeing Counties via public purchase invoices (*ostolaskudata*).
